name: CodeOfEthics
title: Code of Ethics
description: The professional code of ethics affirmed by an intern or member of staff of the centre, clause by clause, and signed.

item.text: I do affirm each of the following as a condition of practising at the centre.
Affirmations
That in the practice of my profession I shall assert the ethical principles of autonomy and justice as a guide to my professional conduct.
That I shall not discriminate against clients on the basis of race, religion, age, gender, disability, nationality, sexual orientation or economic condition.
That I shall maintain objectivity and integrity, and uphold the highest standard in the services I offer.

That I recognise the profession is founded on national standards of competency which promote the best interest of my client, of myself, of the profession and of society; and that ongoing education is a component of professional competency.
That I shall respect the best interest and promote the welfare of the person or group I am working with.
That I shall protect client rights and shall not disclose confidential information acquired during treatment, teaching or investigation without an executed consent.
That I shall safeguard the integrity of the counselling relationship and ensure the client has reasonable access to effective treatment.
That I shall not exploit current or former clients in any manner for personal or agency gain.
That I shall not under any circumstances enter into a sexual, romantic or business relationship with a current or former client.
That I shall terminate the counselling relationship when it is no longer benefiting the client.
That I shall uphold the legal and accepted codes of conduct which pertain to my profession.
That I shall not give false assurances, or make comments or public statements which are not reflective of the current scientific understanding of substance use disorder and its treatment.
That I shall assign credit to all who have contributed to published material and to the work upon which the publication is based.
That I shall abide by and uphold these standards in the conduct of my profession, and that any violation is subject to disciplinary action from the professional body, or revocation of my appointment.
That I shall not use or abuse any illicit substances.
That I shall adhere to all of the codes of ethics above, and that a breach of any of them may lead to disciplinary action.
That, having knowledge of a possible ethical violation, I shall report it to the relevant authority.
